verdict.rationale: Isaac GR00T is described as a generalist humanoid foundation model that can generalize across common tasks and perform multi-step tasks combining general skills. This is adjacent to task planning and execution, but no evidence says tasks can be expressed in natural language. A community report also notes GR00T demos look very slow. missing for 10: explicit natural-language task input, documented language-to-plan-to-execution workflow, hands-on corroboration of execution quality
